title: Online fulfilment business: Georgia and Israel deep edition

questions.q: In "Read your local market Understand", which of these is a key idea?
o: Keep a local address and a named contact in the country where you trade.
Show proof: pack accuracy, dispatch time and damage rate from a pilot seller.
A monthly review: what we planned, what happened, what we change.
Serve one type of seller and one product size first; a wide service hides what works.

questions.q: In "Choose your sector Analyse", which of these is a key idea?
o: Moving data between the two countries or to a third place may need a safeguard; check with a local expert.
Cluster G, Money services (regulated): Regulated money services; plan as a partner of a licensed firm. Check with a local expert.
Languages differ by customer: write the page in the local language plus English.
Both have strong technology and start-up activity; many small firms sell abroad from day one.
